objective: Make whole-system nutrition work plan-driven instead of reactive by adding one persistent factor universe, one compact current master status board, one dependency-propagation graph, and one execution layer without creating a second mutable owner.

role_dispositions.destination: references/nutrition/ideal-nutrition-factor-map.md; remains durable universe/checklist and is not mutable plan state
references/nutrition/method.md; gains canonical four-layer workflow and dependency graph
skills/nutrition.md; gains required read/update rules for the master status board
domains/nutrition.md; remains the only GitHub mutable nutrition owner and now contains the compact Master Status Board
Cronometer remains live owner for diary/targets when connected
Google Calendar remains live owner for current events and timing
TickTick remains live owner for tasks/reminders
Git history and existing history/ nutrition evidence remain available; board summarizes current state only

capability_probes.assertion: A current nutrition question still routes through skills/nutrition.md to domains/nutrition.md and live owners rather than treating the board as a replacement owner.
A material food/amount/timing change cannot be called closed after only macro recalculation; the dependency graph requires affected downstream layers and stale live instructions to be rechecked.
No routing, authority, or write semantics outside nutrition are changed.
Historical recipes/audits remain in history/Git and are not overwritten by the compact current board.

tests.command: grep -q 'Master Status Board' domains/nutrition.md && grep -q 'Canonical four-layer nutrition architecture' references/nutrition/method.md && grep -q 'Dependency propagation graph' references/nutrition/method.md && grep -q 'master status board' skills/nutrition.md
grep -q 'single mutable GitHub owner' domains/nutrition.md && grep -q 'do not create a second mutable nutrition status owner' skills/nutrition.md
